sourceDriftReview.reviewedDifference: Two UI-copy hunks condition the daily-limit retry warning on !isPremium(); no changes to deadline, cancellation, cache, persistence or credit paths.

reviewed.assessment: Restored queue cursor counts retained items before the old index. Explicit pending replacement stages source/binding/recent history, keeps origin raw, rolls state back on failed save, and performs no answer or FSRS credit.

Cross-identity origin must be the declared successor, still authenticates the historical original. Replacement changes only an unanswered slot, its binding and an unanswered placeholder qId. Original raw/time and recorded answers remain separate.

Replacement requires old history and new current entries in all four profiles, exact old recordRevision, absent old current ID and present distinct new ID. Normal inspect/binding validation never aliases old to new. retired is only the declared archived record.

Retired author hydration precedes full saved-source/binding validation; pending old identity blocks response. Replacement is explicit, saved with origin raw, and restores prior in-memory author/presentation/revision on save failure.

Canonical source hashing remains the same. Policy is copied to the generated manifest through the fourth argument; runtime verifier supplies strict identity validation. Current data transport was separately checked against the approved plan.

Document-retained promise invokes the actual source once. Fulfillment/rejection, unchanged token/document/source and actual completion precede waitForGame. Error name/message propagate. Own marker and handle are cleaned in finally; existing caller deadline remains authoritative.

Seven contracts exercise GC collection without navigation, retained pending work despite visible UI, delayed completion, real rejection, changed document/source and fulfilled false. Source read; browser suite not rerun by this reviewer.

One deadline covers auth/headers/body. Abort resolves application ownership even if token ignores signal; per-stage checks prevent late fetch/quota. Cancelled result returns before cache set; binding and same-card checks additionally reject old completions.
Binding compares domain, journey ID, owner and generation. release increments generation before notify. Returning to the same owner cannot revalidate an old generation.
Reviewed timeout, late callback, manual retry, native exit/context release and Premium cases. Test boundaries isolate auth/AI. Existing browser receipts remain the owning agent/root evidence.
